note: Hand-drawn cheat sheet. Moves only: camera positions/angles live in camera-angles.json.

items.name: Static
items.prompt: static locked-off shot, no camera movement

items.name: Pan
items.description: Camera rotates left or right on a fixed point.
items.prompt: camera pans horizontally across the scene

items.name: Tilt
items.description: Camera rotates up or down on a fixed point.
items.prompt: camera tilts vertically, up or down the subject

items.name: Zoom
items.description: Lens focal length changes; camera stays still, framing gets tighter or wider.
items.prompt: zoom in on the subject, camera stays in place

items.name: Roll
items.description: Camera rotates around its lens axis, tilting the horizon.

items.name: Tracking follow
items.description: Camera travels behind or ahead of a subject, moving with them (forward/back).
items.prompt: tracking shot following the subject from behind, camera moves with them

items.name: Tracking lateral
items.description: Camera travels beside the subject, matching their sideways movement.
items.prompt: lateral tracking shot, camera moves sideways alongside the subject

items.name: Arc
items.description: Camera circles around the subject along a curved path.
items.prompt: camera arcs around the subject, orbit move

items.name: Boom
items.description: Camera moves up or down on a crane/jib while still aimed at the subject.
items.prompt: boom shot, camera rises or lowers on a crane

items.name: Pedestal
items.description: Camera moves straight up or down while staying level, no tilt.
items.prompt: pedestal move, camera rises vertically with no tilt

items.name: Pull out / dolly out
items.description: Camera moves backward, away from the subject.
items.prompt: dolly out, camera pulls back to reveal the scene

items.name: Push in / dolly in
items.description: Camera moves forward toward the subject.
items.prompt: dolly in, camera pushes slowly toward the subject
